# Plugins: found off; turned on, one runs (a palette command typing into
# the terminal, a finished command heard, a timer, storage); a broken one
# says why; saving a plugin's file reloads it.
size:1280x800
wait:0.5
key:cmd+shift+p
wait:0.4
type:plugins
wait:0.3
expect-palette:Plugins
key:enter
wait:1.0
page-wait:go
expect-tab:Plugins
expect-page:Hello
expect-page:broken
expect-page:Off
page-click:css:.row[data-name="hello"] input.switch
wait:1.0
expect-page:Running
expect-page:Say Hello
expect-page:timer fired
tab:1
key:cmd+shift+p
wait:0.4
type:say hello
wait:0.3
expect-palette:Hello: Say Hello
key:enter
wait:1.5
expect:plugin-said-hi
wait:0.5
expect-shell:cat @DATA@/plugin-storage/hello.json ==> "count":"1"
tab:2
wait:0.5
expect-page:finished: echo plugin-said-hi
page-click:css:.row[data-name="broken"] input.switch
wait:1.0
page-click:css:.row[data-name="broken"]
wait:0.3
expect-page:Failed:
shell:printf 'libertty.command("Second", () => {});\n' >> @CONFIG@/libertty/plugins/hello/main.js
wait:1.5
page-click:css:.row[data-name="hello"]
wait:0.3
expect-page:Second
shot:plugins.png
# A plugin stuck in a loop stops only itself: the app and the others go on.
page-click:css:.row[data-name="stuck"] input.switch
wait:1.0
tab:1
key:cmd+shift+p
wait:0.4
type:spin
wait:0.3
expect-palette:stuck: Spin
key:enter
wait:1.0
type:echo still-typing
key:enter
wait:1.0
expect:still-typing
tab:2
wait:0.5
page-click:css:.row[data-name="hello"]
wait:0.3
expect-page:Second
